description_en: Creates a TensorBoard by using a job or specifying a data source configuration
description_zh: 创建一个Tensorboard，可以通过一个任务或者指定数据源配置来创建
name: CreateTensorboard

parameters.help_en: The workspace ID
parameters.help_zh: 工作空间ID。<props="china">如何获取工作空间ID，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/449124.html。</props>
parameters.name: workspace_id

parameters.help_en: The job ID. For more information about how to query the job ID, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/459676.html
parameters.help_zh: 任务ID。如何获取任务ID，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/459676.html
parameters.name: job_id

parameters.help_en: The dataset ID
parameters.help_zh: 数据集ID。<props="china">如何获取数据集ID，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/457222.html。</props>
parameters.name: data_source_id

parameters.help_en:
The dataset type. Valid values:

*   OSS
*   NAS
parameters.help_zh:
数据集类型，取值如下：
- OSS
- NAS
parameters.name: data_source_type

parameters.help_en:
The dataset URI:

*   Value format when DataSourceType is set to OSS: `oss://[oss-bucket].[endpoint]/[path]`.
*   Value format when DataSourceType is set to NAS:`nas://[nas-filesystem-id].[region]/[path]`
parameters.help_zh:
数据集的URI：
- 当DataSourceType为OSS时，格式为：`oss://[oss-bucket].[endpoint]/[path]`。
- 当DataSourceType为NAS时，格式为：`nas://[nas-filesystem-id].[region]/[path]`
parameters.name: uri

parameters.help_en: The extended fields of the dataset are in the JSON format. MountPath: the path to mount the dataset
parameters.help_zh: 数据集的扩展字段为JSON格式，当前支持MountPath：自定义数据集挂载的路径
parameters.name: options

parameters.help_en: The directory of summary
parameters.help_zh: Summary目录
parameters.name: summary_path

parameters.help_en: The relative path of summary
parameters.help_zh: Summary相对目录
parameters.name: summary_relative_path

parameters.help_en: The TensorBoard name
parameters.help_zh: Tensorboard名称
parameters.name: display_name

parameters.help_en: The source type
parameters.help_zh: 来源类型
parameters.name: source_type

parameters.help_en: The source ID
parameters.help_zh: 来源ID
parameters.name: source_id

parameters.help_en: The maximum running duration. Unit: minutes
parameters.help_zh: 最长运行时长，单位为：分钟
parameters.name: max_running_time_minutes

element_fields.help_en: The data source type. Only File Storage NAS (NAS) file systems are supported
element_fields.help_zh: 数据源类型，目前仅支持NAS
element_fields.name: data_source_type

element_fields.help_en: The data source ID
element_fields.help_zh: 数据源的唯一标识符
element_fields.name: data_source_id

element_fields.help_en: The data source name
element_fields.help_zh: 数据源显示名称
element_fields.name: display_name

element_fields.help_en: The data source description
element_fields.help_zh: 数据源详细描述
element_fields.name: description

element_fields.help_en: The ID of the NAS file system. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/185212.html
element_fields.help_zh: 阿里云NAS文件系统ID，请参考https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/185212.html
element_fields.name: file_system_id

element_fields.help_en: The path of the Alibaba Cloud Object Storage Service (OSS) file system
element_fields.help_zh: 阿里云OSS文件系统路径
element_fields.name: path

element_fields.help_en: The endpoint of the Alibaba Cloud OSS file system
element_fields.help_zh: 阿里云OSS文件系统服务端点
element_fields.name: endpoint

element_fields.help_en: The configuration options of the Alibaba Cloud OSS file system
element_fields.help_zh: 阿里云OSS文件系统配置选项
element_fields.name: options

element_fields.help_en: The local path of the container that is attached to the runtime of the task
element_fields.help_zh: 挂载到任务运行时的容器的本地路径
element_fields.name: mount_path

element_fields.help_en: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud account that creates the data source
element_fields.help_zh: 数据源创建者的阿里云账号ID
element_fields.name: user_id

element_fields.help_en: The time when the data source was created. The time is displayed in UTC
element_fields.help_zh: 创建时间（UTC）
element_fields.name: gmt_create_time

element_fields.help_en: The time when the data source was last modified. The time is displayed in UTC
element_fields.help_zh: 最后修改时间（UTC）
element_fields.name: gmt_modify_time

parameters.help_en: The configurations of the data source
parameters.help_zh: 数据源配置
parameters.name: data_sources

parameters.help_en: The number of vCPU cores
parameters.help_zh: CPU核数
parameters.name: cpu

parameters.help_en: The memory size. Unit: GB
parameters.help_zh: 内存大小，单位为：GB
parameters.name: memory

element_fields.help_en: The directory prefix of the dataset in the TensorBoard task
element_fields.help_zh: 数据集在Tensorboard任务内的目录前缀
element_fields.name: directory_name

element_fields.help_en: The name of the dataset configurations. In most cases, the name of the dataset configurations is the name of a dataset or task
element_fields.help_zh: 数据集配置的名称。通常为数据集名称或者任务名称
element_fields.name: name

element_fields.help_en: The ID of the dataset configurations. In most cases, the ID of the dataset configurations is the ID of a dataset or task
element_fields.help_zh: 数据集配置的ID。通常为数据集ID，或者任务ID
element_fields.name: id

element_fields.help_en: The file type that corresponds to the URI in the dataset configurations
element_fields.help_zh: 数据集配置的Uri对应文件类型
element_fields.name: data_source_type

element_fields.help_en: The file system URI in the dataset configurations
element_fields.help_zh: 数据集配置中的文件系统Uri
element_fields.name: uri

element_fields.help_en:
The dataset type.

*   datasource: configure a dataset based on the dataset type.
*   dlcjob: configure a dataset based on the task type
element_fields.help_zh:
数据集的类型。
- datasource代表按数据集类型配置。
- dlcjob代表按任务类型配置
element_fields.name: source_type

element_fields.help_en: The summary path
element_fields.help_zh: Summary目录路径
element_fields.name: summary_path

element_fields.help_en: The full summary path
element_fields.help_zh: Summary目录的最终路径
element_fields.name: full_summary_path

parameters.help_en: The configurations of datasets mounted with the TensorBoard job
parameters.help_zh: Tensorboard任务挂载的数据集配置列表
parameters.name: tensorboard_data_sources

fields.help_en: The ID of the virtual private cloud (VPC) configured for the pay-as-you-go Tensorboard task
fields.name: vpc_id

fields.help_en: The specifications of the ECS instance configured for the pay-as-you-go Tensorboard task
fields.help_zh: 后付费Tensorboard任务配置的ECS的规格
fields.name: ecs_type

fields.help_en: The ID of the security group configured for the pay-as-you-go Tensorboard task
fields.help_zh: 后付费Tensorboard任务配置的安全组的ID
fields.name: security_group_id

fields.help_en: The ID of the vSwitch configured for the pay-as-you-go Tensorboard task
fields.name: switch_id

parameters.help_en: The pay-as-you-go configuration of TensorBoard, which is used to create TensorBoard jobs that use pay-as-you-go resources
parameters.help_zh: Tensorboard后付费配置信息，用于创建使用后付费资源的Tensorboard任务
parameters.name: tensorboard_spec

parameters.help_en:
The resource quota ID. This parameter is required when you create a TensorBoard job by using a resource quota.

This feature is currently limited to whitelisted users. If you need to use this feature, contact us
parameters.help_zh:
资源配额ID。使用资源配额的资源创建Tensorboard任务时的必填参数。<props="china">如何获取资源配额ID，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2628071.html。</props>
<props="china">只发布国内站</props>
当前仅白名单用户可以使用资源配额资源创建Tensorboard任务，若需要使用该功能，请和我们联系
parameters.name: quota_id

parameters.help_en:
The priority of the job. Default value: 1. Valid values: 1 to 9.

*   1 is the lowest priority.
*   9 is the highest priority
parameters.help_zh:
任务的优先级，可选参数，默认值 1，参数值的范围是 1~9。其中：
- 1为最低优先级。
- 9为最高优先级
parameters.name: priority

parameters.help_en:
The job visibility. Valid values:

*   PUBLIC: Visible to all members in the workspace.
*   PRIVATE: Visible only to you and the administrator of the workspace
parameters.help_zh:
任务的可见性，取值如下：
- PUBLIC：在此工作空间中，对所有人可见。
- PRIVATE：在此工作空间中，仅对您和管理员可见
parameters.name: accessibility
